notes: The exalted Servant is lifted from the pit and raised toward a high warm radiance — the divine presence is shown ONLY as glowing light, with NO face, NO human body, NO throne-figure of God (John 4:24 honored). An empty stone seat is present but no person of God sits on it. Exaltation to the place of highest honor at the right hand of glory is clearly conveyed (Acts 2:33 / Ps 110:1).
